科研.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.

科研.title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. Robot kinematics and control algorithms are used to ensure that the actions generated by the reinforcement learning algorithm can be executed by the crane. In addition, a customized embedding model is developed to extract information from the construction environment according to user interests. Then, a large language model, ChatGPT 5, is used to update construction progress, provide safety information to control system, and generate construction progress reports. The feasibility of proposed method is verified through several full-scall retaining wall construction experiments.

科研.title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space. The proposed method consists of (1) a generation-based training pipeline that reformulates coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set into a sequential circuit generation problem, and (2) a reward function based on Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) that measures how much a generated circuit contributes to the Pareto front. Evaluation on the RTLLM v2 benchmark shows that the proposed method achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method, while also demonstrating superiority in circuit diversity.

科研.title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. This multi-agent architecture, built around an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm, performs concept extraction, SNOMED-CT grounding, and structured report generation, followed by a speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase, together forming a fully "no-touch" reporting workflow that requires no keyboard input, external API calls, or internet connectivity. We evaluate each pipeline stage individually -- concept extraction, ontology grounding, and concept categorization and report hardware profiling results demonstrating the system's feasibility for real-time, CPU-only clinical deployment.

科研.title: High-dimensional layer-state trajectories reveal the internal dynamics of transformer inference
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mechanistic studies of large language models localize function in parameters, attention heads or neurons, but those parts do not specify how one inference unfolds. We treat the ordered layer-state trajectory as the empirical process and test whether layer order defines a measurable computation. Across representative Qwen, Llama and Gemma checkpoints, realized order produced paths 1.60--2.24 times as aligned with their endpoint chord as endpoint-preserving shuffles. The order effect transferred to a lexical task, but was stronger in three random initializations of the same Qwen architecture, identifying an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law. Direct hidden states provided stronger mechanism coordinates than vocabulary readbacks, and a task-defined coordinate made candidate competition computable. After additive interventions failed, local transition actuators selectively controlled internal trajectories across checkpoints. A confidence gate then drove 17 of 87 held-out Qwen closure trajectories across the full-vocabulary top-1 candidate boundary while leaving all 203 non-closure top-1 outputs unchanged. Safety-matched action reassignment performed similarly, locating the gain in selective gating and the bounded actuator family rather than fine-grained dose assignment. Layer order exposes an observable, computable and behaviourally consequential process of transformer inference without establishing a complete theory of LLM dynamics or control of answer correctness.

科研.title: Dynamic System Inspired Continuous Large Language Model for AI4Science Tasks
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific foundation models increasingly operate on continuous phenomena, yet still use discrete residual computation. We ask whether pretrained residual transformations can support additional latent computation without expanding the backbone. To test this possibility, we introduce Continuum-LM, which reuses these transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model. Its hidden states evolve through an ordinary differential equation evaluated by higher-order numerical integration, with solver order and step size controlling computation. Across eight scientific tasks, Continuum-LM trains stably and improves mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points over discrete counterparts at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales, respectively. At 0.6B, it also outperforms an Ouro-style recurrent control under matched parameter and residual-function evaluation budgets. Together, these results support extensible computational depth through parameter reuse, identifying continuous hidden-state evolution as a practical design dimension for scientific language models beyond parameter scaling.

科研.title: Transformers Learn Two Competing Sorting Algorithms, and Only One Length-Generalizes
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization. One solution class consists of solutions that do not use the second attention layer to sort, but also fail to length-generalize. The other, which uses both attention layers, length-generalizes perfectly, despite only being trained to sort sequences of a fixed length. By carefully choosing the weight initialization, we demonstrate that we can steer the model toward learning one solution or the other. We identify input types that are rare at the training length but increasingly common at longer sequence lengths as a source of this disparity in length-generalization, and find that layer-wise specialization of the second class of solutions allows them to handle these rare sequences more accurately. In the second class, we discover a mechanism by which the second layer attention can use the contextual information gathered by the first layer attention to reduce its search space. On the related task of finding the minimum of a sequence, we find a similar two solution-type phenomenon, but with the opposite generalization pattern, where a different form of layer-wise specialization causes the two-layer solution to length-generalize worse than the single-attention solution.

科研.title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

科研.title: Tailoring Dielectric Relaxation and Charge Transport in Amorphous Ge-Te-Se Phase-Change Materials through Yttrium Incorporation
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) alloys were prepared by a melt-quenching method and characterized using dielectric spectroscopy. The dielectric parameters and electrical conductivity were evaluated to assess their potential for phase-change memory and other electronic applications. The temperature and frequency dependence of the dielectric constants, ac conductivity, and dielectric loss of prepared chalcogenide glassy alloys were investigated over the frequency range 1 Hz - 1 MHz, and the temperature range 302 - 422 K, below the glass transition temperature. Both dielectric loss and dielectric constant were found to decrease with increasing frequency and decreasing temperature. The observed dielectric loss change was interpreted using the Guintini model of dielectric dispersion, correlated barrier hopping (CBH) model, and orientation polarization. The Cole-Cole analysis confirmed a distribution of relaxation times and yielded activation energies consistent with the CBH conduction mechanism. The frequency dependence of the ac conductivity follows the power law (A{\omega}s), where the frequency exponent (s < 1) decreases with increasing temperature, further supporting the CBH conduction mechanism. The incorporation of Y increases the density of localized tail states, resulting in enhanced ac conductivity. These findings suggest that the investigated materials are promising candidates for future phase-change memory and other electronic device applications.

科研.title: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.27014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.

科研.title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.27036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59\% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.

科研.title: An efficient approach to electron-phonon coupling calculations of heterostructures within an all-electron framework
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.27124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A major challenge in calculating electron-phonon coupling at interfaces from first principles is the prohibitive computational cost due to the large supercells involved. Here, we present an efficient approach, which builds the electron-phonon matrix of weakly bound heterostructures from the properties of the isolated layers. The two key ingredients, the dynamical matrices and the potential response, are constructed in two steps. In the expansion step, these quantities are folded from the unit cells onto the supercell through an exact Fourier mapping. In the addition step, the interatomic force constants and the potential responses of the heterostructure are assembled blockwise from the corresponding quantities of the isolated layers, neglecting the weak interlayer contribution. The method is implemented in the electron-phonon module of the all-electron full-potential code exciting, enabling efficient calculations of the electron-phonon self-energy. We demonstrate the approach for the phonon dispersion and spectral functions of bilayer WSe$_2$ and pyridine/MoS$_2$, in comparison with exact reference calculations.

科研.title: Value-level data provenance in an electronic laboratory notebook used by humans and language-model agents: An experience report
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.27859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A published laboratory number can be verified only when its raw file and extraction method are known. This paper presents the value-level provenance architecture of APS ELN, an electronic laboratory notebook used by both researchers and language-model agents. The architecture was motivated by a production audit in a materials laboratory covering projects performed over almost 5 years. Tracing eight baseline studies from sample to stored value showed that the initial ELN structure preserved the link from sample to raw file. Still, the link from raw file to stored value was lost, mainly due to human factors: manual entries carried no file reference or extractor version. To close this gap, the database design and workflow were reworked so that every stored value records its source file, the data file reader/viewer (DFR) plugin and version, any interactive analysis selection, or the server-side formula for derived quantities. An automated drift check re-runs each DFR on the stored files. In two end-to-end validation studies recorded by agents in X-ray reflectivity and tribology, all stored values retained verifiable provenance with zero drift. A comparison with five other platforms shows that none binds individual stored numbers to both their source files and extractor versions.

科研.title: A Multimodal Engineering GraphRAG Framework for Post-Wind-Event Building Assessment and Recovery Inference
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-event building assessment requires linking observed physical damage to its consequences for safety, habitability, functionality, and recovery. Yet post-disaster evidence is often heterogeneous, incomplete, and distributed across images and reconnaissance reports, while recovery models typically require structured engineering inputs. This study develops a multimodal engineering Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework that connects post-wind-event damage evidence to physical consequences, building-condition states, recovery actions, and downtime. Image- and text-based evidence is transformed into a provenance-preserving, component-level representation distinguishing confirmed damage, explicit negative evidence, unresolved conditions, and temporary measures. Graph-aligned retrieval combines comparable building scenarios with explicit engineering relationships, while compatibility, contradiction, evidence-precedence, and abstention mechanisms constrain inference under partial observability. Recovery actions are derived from supported damage-consequence relationships, and downtime uncertainty is propagated through an action-dependency network using Monte Carlo simulation. The framework is demonstrated for tornado-affected low-rise residential buildings using reconnaissance and image-based evidence. Comparisons with BaselineRAG and Structured Baseline RAG show improved agreement for key building-condition and recovery outcomes, together with traceable engineering reasoning and preserved evidence provenance. Ablation analyses demonstrate the contributions of engineering context, evidence safeguards, and graph-path traversal. The results support transparent, recovery-oriented assessment from incomplete multimodal post-event evidence.

科研.title: Discovering Hidden Predictive States in Kinetic Transport
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How do autonomous macroscopic transport laws emerge from kinetic dynamics, and which hidden degrees of freedom must survive coarse-graining? We address these questions by formulating kinetic state reduction as a problem of predictive sufficiency rather than conventional moment truncation. Starting from Boltzmann transport dynamics, we establish a quantitative connection between unresolved microscopic information, irreducible prediction error, and finite-horizon observability. Microscopic preparations with identical macroscopic observables but distinct subsequent evolution provide direct witnesses of incomplete dynamical closure. We develop an entropy-constrained learned state-reduction framework, demonstrated here through linear projections, that identifies the additional predictive states without prescribing their physical identities and determines their necessity through independent response tests, state deletion, and dynamical consistency. An exactly solvable three-velocity model demonstrates that a hidden higher-order moment can influence future energy transport despite identical initial energy and heat flux. Numerical experiments recover this missing direction and reveal how the required state dimension depends on observation scale, prediction horizon, preparation ensemble, and accuracy. In a synthetic 32-channel Boltzmann system, the learned representation identifies predictive combinations spanning multiple kinetic branches and relaxation groups that are not captured by low-order global moments. We further distinguish observable prediction accuracy from autonomous state closure and quantify the information retained through unresolved memory. These results establish an operational framework for testing the emergence of effective transport laws and identifying the microscopic information required for their predictive validity.

科研.title: Variable-Resolution Scattering Reveals Ensemble Properties
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28215v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: SAXS/SANS determine the size and structure of particles and macromolecules in solution. However, the conventional low-angle determination of the radius of gyration, Rg, cannot separately resolve its scattering-weighted mean and the width of its distribution. Because the apparent Rg includes a contribution from ensemble variance, the distribution width is required even to recover the mean Rg. Here, we introduce TENOR-SAXS, a method for estimating the scattering-weighted width of an Rg distribution by applying two anisotropic digital smearings to a single 2D scattering image. Comparing the smeared images provides curvature information unavailable from the conventional radial profile. The resulting observables require no explicit model of the native instrumental point-spread function and show only weak sensitivity over the range of native resolutions typical of SAXS measurements examined here. Analytical expressions are derived in the low-angle and narrow-distribution limits for ensembles described by a known or independently constrained single-particle form factor. For verification, we simulated scattering by particles with several form factors and ensembles with different size distributions, all agree well with the analytical theory. To leading order, the principal observable depends on the scattering-weighted mean and variance rather than on the distribution's functional form or higher moments. For simulated data corresponding to feasible synchrotron exposure times for biological samples, the distribution width and, expressed as a fraction of its mean, was recovered with a typical discrepancy of ~0.1, while the scattering-weighted mean Rg was recovered with ~2% relative discrepancy. TENOR-SAXS thus provides a framework for estimating ensemble width from existing 2D scattering data without explicit instrumental desmearing and for correcting the variance contribution to the apparent radius

科技.title: 10 年来最大底层变革：微软 OneDrive 引入 Hero Links，链接分享后还能随时改权限
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，在昨日（10 月 20 日）举办的 OneDrive 与 Copilot 主题活动中，微软宣布为 OneDrive 和 SharePoint 推出全新的 Hero Links 文件共享体系。微软称， 这是 Microsoft 365 文件共享自 2014 年引入链接共享以来的“十多年来”最大底层变革。 微软表示用户过去分享同一份文件或文件夹，往往需要生成多个共享链接，且不同链接可能对应不同权限，管理起来容易混乱。而 Hero Links 则为每个文件和文件夹提供唯一“主链接”：无论是通过共享对话框复制、以邮件发送，还是直接从浏览器地址栏复制 URL，使用的都是同一个链接。 IT之家援引博文介绍，用户还可以根据使用需求随时调整链接权限，用户在已经分享文件的情况下，依然能直接修改该链接的访问范围，例如从“仅限指定人员”扩大到“组织内可访问”，或在需要时收紧权限，后续无需重新创建并发送新链接。 安全方面，Hero Links 默认仅允许已被添加到该文件或文件夹的用户访问；用户可依据组织政策扩大访问范围，管理员也能为各个 SharePoint 站点或 OneDrive 账户配置默认共享受众。微软还调整了权限管理逻辑，包括允许具备编辑权限的用户重新共享内容，并让文件夹权限变更自动向下应用到其中的文件。 现有共享链接不会失效，仍会在“Other Links（其他链接）”区域中显示和管理。该功能已于 2026 年 10 月开始推送，预计 11 月完成部署。

科技.title: 微软放宽 OneDrive 同步限制：单账户最多可同步 100 万个文件
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，在昨日（10 月 20 日）举办的 OneDrive 与 Copilot 主题活动中， 微软宣布提高 OneDrive 的同步上限，从此前的 30 万个提高到最多 100 万个项目，增幅 233.33%。 微软将 OneDrive 的同步上限提升至最多 100 万个项目，大幅放宽了此前对可同步文件与文件夹数量的限制。对于管理海量文档的企业、学校和机构而言，新上限有望减少拆分文件库或迁移存储位置的需求。 不过 30 万项仍是微软建议的较佳性能阈值，超过后可能出现同步变慢等性能问题。 除同步容量外，微软还针对长期困扰用户的“文件路径过长”问题作出改进。管理员现在可自定义 OneDrive 文件夹名称，从而缩短整体路径长度。 在文件管理体验方面，OneDrive 新增了专门的“快捷方式”文件夹。用户可集中收纳快捷方式，避免它们与真实文件夹混杂在“我的文件”根目录中。 为了帮助 IT 管理员更高效地监控、排查和自动化管理企业内 OneDrive 同步部署，微软还推出了 OneDrive Sync Client 命令行界面（CLI），该工具目前以 odsync 命令在预览版中亮相，正式发布时间尚未公布。 管理员过去虽然能看到哪些设备运行正常或不符合合规要求，但要进一步定位同步故障，往往仍需逐台设备手动检查。新 CLI 希望“命令化”这一过程，管理员可通过终端获取实时状态，并将常见检查与修复流程写成脚本，批量执行，从而减少重复劳动。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 从微软展示的功能看，OneDrive Sync CLI 可查询设备上已配置的 OneDrive 账户、客户端与 CLI 版本、文件夹备份设置、已应用的策略，以及客户端、账户和文件夹备份的整体状态。它还支持同时处理多个已配置账户，并可针对特定账户缩小查询范围。

科技.title: 核能“充电宝”来了：微型反应堆产业平台成立，我国微堆迈入商业化阶段
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，据央视新闻报道，10 月 20 日，四川能源核产业有限公司正式揭牌，核心业务就是聚焦 先进微型核反应堆 的技术研发与产业化，标志着我国微堆技术正式从实验室走向工程化应用的新阶段。 IT之家从报道中获悉，微型核反应堆是一种电功率不超过 10 兆瓦的先进核能装置。与传统核电站不同，它并非简单地将大型反应堆缩小，而是一种从设计之初就追求 固有安全、极致小巧 的全新核能装置。 中国核动力研究设计院副总工程师崔怀明介绍， 微堆堆芯大小与家用冰箱相近 ，两三个集装箱就能装入整个发电系统，无论是地上的卡车、天上的飞机，还是海里的轮船，都能运输。 中国核动力研究设计院在全球首次提出了铀氢锆燃料铅铋冷却微堆技术路线，它是一种使用铀氢锆核燃料并采用液态铅铋合金作为冷却剂的微型核反应堆。 在海岛、偏远矿区、远海平台等场景，无论是架设输电线路还是柴油供电，都面临成本高、运输难等痛点。微堆正好可以解决这些难题， 它可移动部署，通过公路或船舶运到现场，快速接入，提供长达数年的稳定电力； 也可以充当基荷能源，与风光形成“核 — 风 — 光”多能互补；热电联供还可实现能量梯级利用，余热用于海水淡化、工业供汽、海底牧场养殖等，极大提升综合能源利用率。 中国核动力研究设计院四所副所长孙超认为， 微堆的核心安全优势来自“固有安全燃料 + 固有安全堆型”的双重叠加 ，它采用的铀氢锆燃料，自带“刹车”功能， 一旦温度升高，核反应会自动减弱，甚至停止反应 ，从根本上防止反应失控。由于固有安全性高，微堆无需配套安全壳设施、无需设置场外应急体系，将工程整体建设周期压缩至 30 个月以内。

科技.title: 中国电信孵化的具身公司“伽马智能”成立，推进人形机器人“自进化”
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，中国电信人工智能研究院（TeleAI）10 月 20 日官宣，具身智能公司“伽马智能（Gamma Robtics）”近日在上海市徐汇区注册成立。 该公司是 TeleAI 孵化的首个市场化创新企业 ，聚焦自进化人形机器人全模型创新及应用，并将与 TeleAI 共建人形机器人实验室，联合推动科研成果转化为面向产业真实场景的产品与服务。 伽马智能由 中电信（上海）人工智能产业私募基金 进行战略投资，中国电信集团 CTO、首席科学家、中国电信人工智能研究院（TeleAI）院长李学龙教授出任科学顾问，白辰甲博士任创始人及首席执行官。 IT之家查询发现，中电信（上海）人工智能产业私募基金由中国电信携手上海国投先导基金、央企战略性新兴产业发展基金、徐汇区下属上海汇资等机构共同出资设立，形成“央企 + 地方国资 + 国家级战新基金”的多层次资本架构。 依托中国电信在通信、网络、算力、数据、场景的核心优势，以及 TeleAI 的新一代通信网 —— 智传网（AI Flow）的创新能力， 伽马智能将重点围绕人形机器人的“自进化”与“全身模型”推进研发 ，致力于实现机器人在真实交互应用中持续学习，形成移动、平衡与操作相互协同的全身能力，并与云端模型和各种智能节点深度协作，支持机器人共享经验、协同完成任务。

科技.title: 亚马逊 CTO Dr. Werner Vogels：二十余年技术实践，想与创业者分享这 4 点
科技.summary: 在 2026 年 亚马逊云科技软件企业峰会创业加速营巅峰路演 上，亚马逊副总裁兼首席技术官 Werner Vogels 博士与极客公园创始人 & CEO 张鹏进行了一场极具深度的炉边对谈。 面对当下狂热的 AI 创业潮与复杂的技术演进，Vogels 博士分享了亚马逊云科技走过二十年的底层商业逻辑，并为初创企业给出了极具实操性的避坑建议。 左：亚马逊副总裁兼首席技术官 Werner Vogels 博士 右：极客公园创始人 & CEO 张鹏 以下是两位对谈内容的精华梳理： 01 起点与颠覆： 被逼出来的创新与 彻底改变的 IT 商业模式 张鹏：您在二十年前加入了亚马逊，那时的亚马逊还只是一家相对较小的初创公司。究竟是什么真正吸引了您，并让您在这里坚守了二十多年？ Dr. Werner Vogels： 吸引我留下的， 首先是那些在外部根本看不到的、被现实「逼」出来的硬核技术挑战，我们不断在底层技术上做出了创新。 二十年前，当我真正走进亚马逊的「技术厨房」时，我被震撼了。 当时市面上没有任何现成的商业软件能支撑亚马逊电商海量并发的规模。比如，我们曾试图用传统的、单体架构的商业关系型数据库去承载所有的互联网流量，结果遭遇了灾难性的宕机。 这段惨痛的经历逼着我们明白，在互联网规模下，没有一种传统的商业数据库能包打天下。 因此，我们不得不从零开始，根据实际的业务场景自主研发的基础设施，比如后来专为海量键值查询设计的分布式数据库 Dynamo。 但让我最自豪的，是 我们更彻底颠覆了传统 IT 行业的商业模式 。在亚马逊云科技出现之前，企业使用 IT 基础设施就像是被供应商「绑架」。 你必须预测未来 5 年的需求，提前开出数百万美元的支票购买硬件和商业许可。一旦钱交出去，供应商就不再关心你的死活。 而我们把亚马逊「以客户为中心」的理念带到了 IT 领域：按需使用、用多少付多少，随时可以解约等等。在我们的模式里，只有客户真正取得了商业成功，亚马逊云科技才会成功。 亚马逊副总裁兼首席技术官 Werner Vogels 博士 02 抛弃炒作幻象： 去解决真正硬核的人类问题 张鹏：我见过许多初创公司失败，是因为他们选择了一个「太小」或者缺乏长期价值的问题。在风口不断变换的今天，创业者应该用什么原则来判断一个问题是否真正值得他们倾注数年人生去解决？ Dr. Werner Vogels： 现在的创业圈有一种浮躁的倾向，大家似乎都把「成为估值极高的独角兽」或「一夜暴富」当成了唯一目标。特别是现在，很多人只是在大模型之上包了一层很薄的皮，这没有任何可防御的技术护城河，纯粹是为了追逐风口。 我认为一家真正有价值的初创企业，应该把目标放在「解决硬核的真实痛点」上。你需要把目光从虚荣的估值上移开，去环顾四周，寻找那些你的客户正在痛苦挣扎、且没有任何人去解决的问题。 当你因为深刻的行业认知而解决了一个独特的问题时，商业变现和赚钱只是水到渠成、自然而然的副产品。 极客公园创始人 & CEO 张鹏 03 创新者的品味： 源于对痛点的极致同理心与热情 张鹏：许多优秀的创新往往来自于在选择问题时展现出的极好「品味」。通过您走访全球技术人的经历，您觉得这种发现好问题的敏锐度是如何培养出来的？ Dr. Werner Vogels： 好的品味，往往源于创业者对某个特定痛点有着极致的同理心和近乎狂热的激情。 我们在印尼遇到的一家初创公司 HARA，他们发现当地小农户因为没有合法数字身份而无法获得低息贷款，只能忍受高达近 40% 的高利贷。由于创始人就出身于农户家庭，他们深刻理解这个痛点，于是通过建立农户的数字身份和预估产量数据，完美打通了银行与农户的信任桥梁。 这套数据不仅解决了社会难题，也成为了他们极具价值的商业护城河。 你所解决的问题不一定非要是拯救世界的大危机。关键在于， 你必须对你试图解决的问题充满真正的激情，因为在迎来商业成功之前，你必然要经历一段漫长且痛苦的煎熬。只有靠激情，你才能坚持下来。 04 初创企业的生存法则： 绝不妥协的安全与极致的云原生 张鹏：对于资源永远处于紧缺状态的初创公司来说，他们常常会犯两个错：要么到处偷工减料，要么试图一开始就构建完美复杂的系统。对于那些今天只有很少请求，但渴望明天能爆发式增长的团队，您认为什么是绝对不能偷工减料的？ Dr. Werner Vogels： 第一原则：在任何情况下，安全都必须是你的「第一要务（Job Zero）」。 没有安全，你的业务随时会归零。 很多团队为了抢速度而在初期忽略安全，指望以后再修补，但事后整合安全的成本和难度是几何级增加的。 你甚至现在就应该采用抗量子加密技术（Quantum-safe encryption）来保护数据，因为一旦发生数据泄露，即使是当下的加密，几年后也可能被轻易破解。 在确保了安全底线之后，我的核心建议是：千万不要把宝贵的早期资源浪费在基础设施的底层运维上。 去拥抱无服务器计算（Serverless）和专为云打造的托管数据库。如果你担心产品一夜爆红后系统会崩溃，就不要再用传统的虚拟机去硬扛流量，而是去使用 Amazon Lambda，或者像 Amazon DynamoDB 这样的专有数据库系统。 你只需要专注编写核心的业务逻辑，把根据流量自动扩容、防范系统崩溃的脏活累活，全部交给亚马逊云科技来做。 05 AI 时代的风险控制 与技术人的终极责任 张鹏：AI 时代，我们只需动动嘴，AI 就能生成大量代码。在一切都加速的时代，创造者们面临的新使命和挑战是什么？ Dr. Werner Vogels： AI 确实带来了极大的效率飞跃，但我们也必须认清这背后的巨大风险。 我们现在是用一种天然带有模糊性的语言（人类自然语言），去命令机器生成要求绝对精确的执行代码。 很多时候，你不能完全盲信 AI。特别是在金融、医疗等受强监管的领域，如果 AI 犯了致命错误，你绝对不能对监管机构说「这不怪我，是 AI 干的」。 技术圈有一句铁律：你构建了它，你就必须为它负责（You build it, you own it）。这也是为什么在 AI 时代，形式化验证、自动化推理以及代码开源审查，反而变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。 最后，我想谈谈技术人的社会责任。随着技术的规模与影响力越来越大，我们肩上的责任也前所未有地沉重。坦白讲，我不认为过去二十年爆发的所有技术都让人类变得更幸福了，很多人甚至变成了被屏幕和算法控制的数字瘾君子。 作为技术的缔造者，我们有责任去修复这些问题。我强烈呼吁所有创业者和工程师，即使你们一周要高强度工作 80 个小时，也请试着抽出 5 个小时，用你们的技术专长去帮助那些非营利组织，去为社会「向善」做一点贡献。 亚马逊的 CEO Andy Jassy 曾说过一句话：「经验没有压缩算法」（There is no compression algorithm for experience）。AI 的真正价值，绝不是彻底取代人类，而是去极大地放大我们人类真正宝贵的特质：同理心、判断力、创造力，以及无可替代的真实经验。 未来的技术走向并不在我手中，而在你们每一个人手中。请确保你们今天构建的系统，在长远来看，能真正让这个社会变得更好。 *头图来源： 亚马逊云科技
